Join to apply for the Senior HR Generalist - Americas role at Canonical

Join to apply for the Senior HR Generalist - Americas role at Canonical

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder led, profitable and growing.
We require an HR function that thinks and acts globally. We're looking for a Senior HR Generalist to offer their expertise to our AMER region. It's an exciting time to join with the opportunity to help shape and create an HR function for the future. The senior role will serve as a driver and practitioner in both regional and global HR initiatives. You will join a global team of HR professionals to provide precise, compliant and scalable HR operations to the business, advise and execute on HR issues across the whole employee life-cycle, and partner with leadership in your region. You will have an analytical approach, a keen eye for detail and the ability to interpret data trends and themes.
Location: This role will be based remotely in the AMER region
The role entails

  • Deliver precise and compliant HR operations in a timely manner and with the highest degree of accuracy
  • Interact closely with the Americas HR Manager and the Global Head of HR to create impact across all HR regions
  • Be accountable for HR processes such as talent development, succession planning, performance assessments, onboarding, culture and engagement initiatives that drive a high performing team
  • Work with managers across the business on performance management, organizational design, employee engagement, rewards- and workforce planning
  • Partner with the HRIS team to develop and refine operational processes for day to day HR administration
  • Coach and advise people managers on the full spectrum of employee relations issues across multiple countries
  • Partner with people managers to support the delivery of appropriate training and development programs
  • Establish a trusted partnership with the business in your region
  • Drive diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives
  • Design new policies and deliver on business-critical HR related projects globally
What we are looking for in you
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • HR experience leading initiatives across regions within a technology business
  • Regional HR experience within Latin America (Brazil and/or Mexico is a plus), with an understanding of local labor laws, competitive awareness and insights
  • Experience in business partnering with senior stakeholders
  • A good balance between leading and executing, in this role you will need to be hands-on involved in the daily HR routines
  • Experience mentoring and developing others
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to define done and keep deliverables on track
  • Experience in working in a remote first organization
  • Able to leverage data to make informed decisions
  • Fluent in business English (written and spoken)
  • Self motivated, organized, accurate, confident, authentic, results-orientated, open-minded and enthusiastic
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
Nice to have skills
  • Experience with immigration policies and mobility processes
  • Payroll and/or benefits oversight experience
  • Knowledge of HR Systems and databases
  • Professional HR certification(s)
  • Facilitation skills
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Médicos Especialistas Parceiros | Genética

Hybrid São Paulo, SP, BR

Somos a Alice, o primeiro plano de saúde do Brasil com time de saúde.
Acreditamos em um modelo de saúde inovador e colocamos o nosso membro no centro das decisões por meio da tecnologia, empatia, transparência e simplicidade.
A nossa missão é tornar o mundo mais saudável e este não é um desafio fácil. Revolucionar a saúde no Brasil requer resiliência, energia e inovação.
Por causa da nossa tecnologia própria, somos capazes de integrar nossos parceiros e garantir que nosso Time de Saúde acompanhe cada membro de perto.
Conectamos, de maneira simples e estruturada, toda a jornada de saúde dos membros da Alice (histórico de saúde, agendamentos, exames etc), o que nos permite fazer uma gestão da saúde completa e precisa de cada pessoa.

Local da prestação de serviços
Serão diferentes oportunidades em São Paulo, cada uma atuando em diferentes locais:

A atuação médica será realizada no seu próprio consultório e ele deverá estar localizado em um destes locais.

Sobre a parceria:
Como geneticista parceiro(a) que presta serviço na Alice, você será responsável por realizar consultas dos membros encaminhados pela atenção primária para sua especialidade.

Requisitos para a parceira:

  • Médico(a) com residência concluída e/ou título em Genética
  • Ter disponibilidade de agenda em até 7 dias úteis
  • Ter disponibilidade para consultas presenciais e online
  • Utilizar a tecnologia Alice tanto para assuntos administrativos (exemplo: elegibilidade), quanto assistenciais (ex: prontuário)
  • Ter as lógicas de cuidado e protocolos Alice como um norte para o cuidado dos nossos membros
  • Atuação SEMPRE baseada em evidência científica, buscando chegar nos desfechos da forma mais custo efetiva
  • Abertura para atuar em conjunto com a atenção primária da Alice e demais especialistas no cuidado do membro
  • Interesse por estar sempre se desenvolvendo e atualizando seu conhecimento técnico

Somos uma Healthtech fundada em 2019 com o propósito de tornar o mundo mais saudável; o que isso quer dizer, na prática, é que estamos trabalhando duro todos os dias para construir o que um sistema de saúde eficiente e humano deveriam ser.

Não é sobre usar tecnologia para um problema irrelevante ou pequeno, mas sim, repensar como a tecnologia deveria ser usada para gerar mais saúde e mais cuidado para as pessoas

Saúde está entre os maiores desafios da nossa geração: experiência subótima, baixos resultados na geração de saúde e custo exponencialmente crescente.

Alice é um novo capítulo em planos de saúde, implementando uma abordagem de cuidado coordenado e continuado, através de metodologias e tecnologias próprias, pensadas com o Membro no centro das decisões.

Para isso, buscamos um profissional que nos ajude, cada vez mais, a transformar vidas.

QUEM SOMOS:

A Fresenius Medical Care (FME) tem como propósito fundamental melhorar a vida dos pacientes com doença renal crônica (DRC), oferecendo-lhes um serviço integral, caracterizado pela mais alta tecnologia para o tratamento de diálise e o apoio permanente de uma equipe especializada, profissional e comprometida com a saúde do paciente.

title: Data Management Operations Specialist
description:
Job Overview:
We are seeking a highly skilled and proactive

Job Overview:
We are seeking a highly skilled and proactive Data Management Operations Specialist to join our Data Management team in the insurance industry. This individual will play a critical role in supporting the Data Management Strategy and Operations Leader by overseeing the daily operations of our data management processes, ensuring the accuracy, accessibility, and compliance of data, and implementing strategic initiatives aimed at optimizing data governance and quality. This is a unique opportunity to work closely with senior leadership and contribute to the evolution of data management within a fast-paced and highly regulated industry.
Key Responsibilities:

  • Support Data Operations: Assist in managing the end-to-end data lifecycle, from data acquisition and processing to storage, usage, and retirement. Ensure consistent, high-quality data availability across business units.
  • Data Governance and Compliance: Collaborate with the Data Governance team to ensure that data practices are in line with regulatory requirements (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, and industry-specific standards) and organizational policies.
  • Data Quality Assurance: Monitor and maintain data integrity and consistency across various systems. Identify and address data quality issues, collaborating with technical teams for remediation.
  • Data Reporting & Analytics: Support the generation of data reports for both operational and strategic decision-making. Analyze data trends and patterns to provide actionable insights.
  • Process Optimization: Continuously evaluate data management workflows and recommend improvements to streamline processes, enhance data accessibility, and reduce manual effort.
  • Collaboration: Act as a liaison between technical teams, business stakeholders, and leadership to ensure alignment on data management objectives, projects, and outcomes.
  • Documentation & Training: Maintain comprehensive documentation for data management processes, workflows, and policies. Provide training and support to staff on best practices related to data usage and governance.
  • Technology Integration: Assist in the integration of new data management tools and technologies to improve operational efficiency and data governance standards.
Functional Skills:
  • Data Management & Governance: Strong understanding of data management principles, including data classification, data lineage, data security, and data privacy, with the ability to apply them in a regulated industry.
  • Business Process Management: Knowledge of insurance industry operations, with the ability to translate business requirements into actionable data management strategies and improvements.
  • Compliance & Regulatory Knowledge: Familiarity with industry regulations such as GDPR, HIPAA, and Solvency II, ensuring data management practices are compliant with legal standards.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Effective communication skills to collaborate across departments and manage expectations, ensuring alignment on data-related objectives.
  • Problem-Solving & Analytical Thinking: Ability to identify inefficiencies or risks in data management processes and develop solutions to mitigate them.
Technical Skills:
  • Data Management Tools: Proficiency in data management platforms (e.g., Informatica, Talend, Collibra, Alteryx) and business intelligence tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Qlik).
  • Database Knowledge: Familiarity with relational databases (SQL Server, Oracle, DB2) and big data technologies (e.g., Hadoop, Spark) to assist in data operations and troubleshooting.
  • Data Modeling & ETL: Experience with data modeling, ETL processes, and data warehousing techniques to ensure accurate and efficient data integration.
  • Data Quality Tools: Experience with data profiling, data quality assessment, and monitoring tools to ensure data is fit for use.
  • Scripting & Automation: Basic knowledge of scripting languages (e.g., Python, SQL) to automate data processing and ensure consistency across platforms.

  • Conhecimento em legislação trabalhista e previdenciária;

  • Conhecimento em sistemas de folha de pagamento e ponto eletrônico;
  • Boa comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal;
  • Organização e proatividade.

title: BANCO DE TALENTOS - HOSPITAL CARDOSO FONTES
description:
Desde dezembro de 2024, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Cardoso Fontes .

O Hospital Cardoso Fontes é direcionado ao atendimento de média e alta complexidade. É uma das principais referências hospitalares da Zona Oeste do Rio de Janeiro. A unidade é reconhecida por sua atuação na área de fisioterapia oncológica, ginecologia, nefrologia (sistema urinário) e tratamentos em crianças com insuficiência renal, pneumologia e urologia .

Formação de acordo com a função exercida;

Experiência mínima de 06 (seis) meses comprovadas na área de atuação.

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e municipal, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e educação, além de ser uma organização social habilitada em vários estados, gerenciando serviços e organizações de saúde por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde, voltada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo suas áreas de atuação com projetos em desenvolvimento na área de Assistência Social e Educação. Essa gama de atividades consolida a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, buscando sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais altamente capacitados e com notável expertise.

Assim, a SPDM contribui efetivamente para a melhoria contínua dos serviços do Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando garantir a universalidade e oportunidades de acesso à saúde, essenciais ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para isso, combina tecnologia de ponta com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, incluindo enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades em 2001 no município de São Paulo, expandindo-se para outros municípios e estados. Desde então, busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde oferecidos aos usuários do SUS.

O programa tem como objetivo promover mudanças nos indicadores de saúde e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma gestão estratégica e aprimoramento contínuo dos serviços.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Periodicamente, publica anúncios recrutando esses profissionais nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios onde estão suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas à gestão pública, beneficiando a população de forma ética, humanizada, com qualidade técnica, compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis de assistência, garantindo atendimento de qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

Overview:
We are looking for a highly experienced Edge Network Engineer to lead complex edge, network, and cloud platform deployments. This role will act as a technical lead and subject matter expert during onboarding, migrations, and new platform integrations. Success in this role requires exceptional technical knowledge, strong communication skills, and the ability to lead both technical workstreams and customer expectations.
The Edge Network Engineer position provides customer facing network design, implementation, configuration standardization as it relates to network routing protocols, switching and security methodology. As part of the Edge Network Engineering team, this role also serves as a Tier 4 escalation point from the global support organization.
Experience with SD-WAN—especially Versa Networks—is a major asset and will elevate your candidacy.
Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead customer deployments of edge computing infrastructure, cloud integration, and SD-WAN platforms.
  • Act as the technical point of contact for end-to-end implementation activities, including architecture planning, configuration, testing, and go-live support.
  • Work closely with project managers, systems engineers, and customer stakeholders to align on design and timelines.
  • Troubleshoot deployment issues across operating systems, hypervisors, containers, and networks.
  • Develop automation scripts and reusable tooling to improve speed and consistency of deployments within the larger context of the company strategy.
  • Document procedures, configurations, and lessons learned; contribute to internal knowledge bases.
  • Mentor junior engineers and participate in internal enablement and cross-functional collaboration.
  • Participate in periodic customer workshops to review implementation design as needed to support large-scale or complex rollouts.
Qualifications:
  • Extensive experience in Linux system administration and troubleshooting.
  • Proficiency with Type 1 and Type 2 hypervisors (e.g., KVM, VMware).
  • Familiarity with containerization technologies; experience with lightweight Kubernetes distributions (e.g., K3s) preferred.
  • Strong understanding of networking principles including routing, VLANs, firewalls, DNS, NAT, Routing protocols and proxies.
  • Hands-on experience configuring and managing network interfaces, both physical and virtual.
  • Prior experience with SD-WAN deployment and management; Versa SD-WAN experience is a strong plus.
  • Proficiency in using tools such as tcpdump, Wireshark, iptables, netstat, and other network diagnostic utilities.
  • Experience with cloud service providers such as Azure or AWS, including VM provisioning, datastore configuration, and SSO setup.
  • Comfortable working with REST APIs and using tools like Postman, Swagger, curl, and Python scripts for automation and testing.
  • Awareness of secure deployment principles; familiarity with TPM, encryption, and measured boot is a plus (can be trained internally).
  • Familiarity with infrastructure automation tools such as Ansible, Terraform, or Bash scripting.
  • Experience with tools like ServiceNow, Jira, or other ITSM platforms for Project/Change/Incident management.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to clearly document issues, escalate appropriately, and collaborate across teams.
  • Fluent in English
Preferred Background:
  • 5+ years in edge infrastructure deployment, implementation engineering, or similar technical field.
  • Experience supporting or deploying edge orchestration platforms (e.g., Zededa, Azure IoT Edge, AWS Greengrass).
  • Experience with zero-touch provisioning, telemetry pipelines, or site/network architecture at the edge is a plus.
Why Join Us?
  • Work at the cutting edge of network operations, edge computing/networking, and satellite systems, enabling global connectivity in the most remote and demanding scenarios.
  • Be part of a collaborative, fast-moving team that values technical depth, mentorship, and continuous learning.

Find great opportunities to make an impact. We have a "one team, one dream" mentality. We work together to make great things happen. Working at Speedcast isn't just a job, it's a career that you can take to new levels.

title: Banco de Talentos
description:
A Inspetoria São João Bosco é mais do que uma organização; somos uma comunidade apaixonada que acredita no incrível potencial das pessoas para construir uma sociedade verdadeiramente justa e solidária. Estamos comprometidos com a promoção dos direitos das crianças e dos adolescentes, e a nossa missão é uma jornada dedicada a esse propósito.

Agora, convidamos você a embarcar nessa jornada conosco e fazer parte da nossa missão e compromisso social. Se, por acaso, você não encontrou a vaga que estava buscando, não desanime! Este espaço é o lugar ideal para você deixar seus dados cadastrados conosco.

Ao se juntar à Família Salesiana, você não está apenas entrando em uma empresa; está abraçando uma causa nobre e se tornando parte de uma comunidade que valoriza o impacto positivo que cada pessoa pode ter na sociedade. Venha fazer parte dessa jornada incrível e ajude-nos a construir um mundo melhor, onde o amor, a educação e a solidariedade são nossas maiores forças.

Após a conclusão do seu cadastro em nosso Banco de Talentos, seus valiosos dados serão cuidadosamente mantidos em nossa página na plataforma da Gupy.

Isso significa que, à medida que novas oportunidades alinhadas com suas habilidades e competências surgirem, entraremos em contato. Portanto, mantenha sempre suas informações de cadastro atualizadas e prepare-se para abraçar desafios empolgantes e crescer profissionalmente conosco. Sua próxima grande aventura está prestes a começar!

Em um processo seletivo, o conhecimento técnico, embora importante, nem sempre é o único fator decisivo para garantir a sua contratação. Existem diversos aspectos que podem fazer de você a pessoa candidata ideal em qualquer seleção, tais como:

  • Proatividade
  • Senso de responsabilidade
  • Criatividade
  • Capacidade de lidar com pressão e imprevistos
  • Habilidade para trabalhar em equipe
  • Disponibilidade
  • Flexibilidade
  • Versatilidade
  • Comunicabilidade
  • Energia e disposição

Estamos à procura de profissionais que compartilhem da mesma visão e se identifiquem com os nossos valores. Acreditamos que você possa ser a pessoa que estamos procurando.

Os Salesianos não realizam seus processos seletivos por meio de empresas terceirizadas. O recrutamento e seleção são conduzidos diretamente pelas unidades, sem qualquer necessidade de investimento financeiro por parte dos candidatos.

Descrição da empresa

A Inspetoria São João Bosco (ISJB) é parte de uma instituição global com presença em diversos países do redor do mundo, os Salesianos . Em todo planeta, os Salesianos são conhecidos por suas obras educacionais, de ação social e evangelização , e, no Brasil, somos divididos em inspetorias, organizadas por divisão geográfica.

A ISJB é mantenedora de unidades nos estados de Minas Gerais, Espírito Santo, Rio de Janeiro, Goiás, Distrito Federal e Tocantins e nosso Centro Inspetorial (a sede administrativa) se localiza em Belo Horizonte/MG. São 14 comunidades canônicas, que gerenciam as obras, que se dividem nos seguintes segmentos de atuação:

SEGMENTO EDUCAÇÃO

A ISJB é responsável por 12 Escolas Salesianas espalhadas pelo Brasil, que atuam desde a educação infantil até o ensino médio e um Centro Universitário, o UniSales, na cidade de Vitória/ES. Uma educação católica de excelência, que se utiliza das mais avançadas técnicas pedagógicas contemporâneas.

SEGMENTO AÇÃO SOCIAL

A ISJB mantém em sua área de atuação geográfica 4 CESAMs, que são referência nacional na aprendizagem juvenil profissionalizante, além de 5 Centros Juvenis, 1 Pré-vestibular social, 20 Oratórios Festivos e 3 Oratórios diários. É o legado de Dom Bosco, e o seu reconhecido método preventivo em ação, para quem mais precisa.

SEGMENTO PASTORAL (EVANGELIZAÇÃO)

Somos Salesianos de Dom Bosco, e na esfera pastoral, a ISJB mantém 12 paróquias e 6 capelas salesianas, além de suas obras de formação religiosa (um aspirantado, um pré-noviciado e um noviciado), uma Casa de Retiro e um Centro de Documentação.

Localizado em Belo Horizonte/MG, é responsável pela administração das obras em escala nacional, e onde estão sediados os escritórios administrativos da inspetoria.

Title: Technology Value Realization Specialist

Description:

Aramco energizes the world economy.

Aramco occupies a special position in the global energy industry. We are one of the world’s largest producers of hydrocarbon energy and chemicals, with among the lowest Upstream carbon intensities of any major producer.

With our significant investment in technology and infrastructure, we strive to maximize the value of the energy we produce for the world along with a commitment to enhance Aramco’s value to society.

Headquartered in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and with offices around the world, we combine market discipline with a generations’ spanning view of the future, born of our nine decades experience as responsible stewards of the Kingdom’s vast hydrocarbon resources. This responsibility has driven us to deliver significant societal and economic benefits to not just the Kingdom, but also to a vast number of communities, economies, and countries that rely on the vital and reliable energy that we supply.

We are one of the most profitable companies in the world, as well as amongst the top five global companies by market capitalization.

Overview

We are seeking a Technology Value Realization Specialist to join our Technology Strategy & Planning Department (TSPD).

TSPD’s mission is to provide high-impact leadership and support across the technology life-cycle, from strategy setting to value realization and sustainable growth, and partner with corporate and business stakeholders to integrate new technologies into the company’s strategies and investment plans.

Your primary role is to play a central part in the corporate stage-gate and value realization process. You will provide leadership in the implementation, governance and sustainable capability needed to support full integration, application and continuous improvement of the technology stage-gate process.

Key Responsibilities

As the successful candidate you will be required to perform the following:

  • Support the company-wide roll-out of the Technology Realized Value (TRV) KPI validation and reporting process in partnership with Upstream, Downstream, Finance & Technology Organizations.
  • Manage and oversee the technology stage-gate process, including ongoing implementation to support R&D, technology development, demonstration and deployment, and transition to operations in order to enable value realization from technology investments.
  • Provide leadership for scientists, engineers, and other business/functional specialists to enable de-risking and go/no go decisions for R&D projects, ensuring technical-commercial readiness prior to deployment and value realization.
  • Serve as an internal consultant for project teams on the development of robust business cases, deployment and value realization strategies, including partnering with technical, commercial and business leads to implement robust commercial review process to maximize financial return and strategic impact from R&D projects.
  • Assess technology stage-gate practices and related activities across the Company, in order to maintain high-standards and compliance with the Corporate Technology Development General Instructions.
  • Partner with R&D staff and stakeholders in technology, business and supporting functions, in order to ensure alignment across all areas and to support a smooth transition and adoption of the enhanced technology management processes.
  • Provide expert guidance to project teams and technology/executive management on related activities, including business case development, IP and commercial strategy, supply chain development, deployment plans, business models, value realization and related techno-economics.

Minimum Requirements

  • You must hold a Bachelor degree in Science or Engineering. An advanced degree (MBA/Finance) is highly desirable.

  • Pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Projetos, Engenharia Elétrica ou áreas afins
  • Conhecimentos em normas técnicas voltadas a projetos de subestações (ANEEL, ONS, ABNT, NR-10, entre outras)
  • Certificação PMP ou equivalente
  • Conhecimento em Microsoft Dynamics

Nós crescemos juntos, porque pensamos e trabalhamos pelo sucesso comum. Fazer parte do time Brasol significa jogar junto, sempre comprometidos com os resultados, promovendo um ambiente de desenvolvimento contínuo, com visão de negócio, enfatizando a aprendizagem e estimulando o protagonismo.

Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry’s digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity.
Xometry is looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our growing organization. The right person will help move our machine learning capabilities to the next level. You’ll be working in an organization where AI is the enabler and center of its core business strategy. You want to be part of a small, intensely skilled team, who feel total ownership of their work, and can’t imagine a day without learning & coding. You will play a crucial role in the Xometry platform and everything you do will matter.
What You’ll Do:

  • At Xometry, you will play a crucial role in exploring new machine learning opportunities, researching and performing proof of concepts, and bringing new machine learning and AI solutions into Xometry’s platform
  • Develop and implement machine learning models that improve Xometry’s ability to predict cost, price, and sourcing options for our customers and suppliers.
  • You will be responsible for leading the evaluation of emerging technologies, identifying areas for improvement, and developing new features while ensuring the reliability and scalability of Xometry’s platform
  • Lead the exploration of emerging AI and machine learning technologies and develop proof-of-concepts to assess their potential impact on Xometry’s platform
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements, prioritize features, and define technical solutions based on the latest innovations
  • Monitor machine learning models and AI performance and troubleshoot issues as they arise
  • Contribute to the documentation and knowledge base to help other teams understand and use Xometry’s AI effectively
What We’re Looking For:
  • Experience with state of the art ML modeling techniques and approaches like transformers, self supervised pre-training, generative modeling, LLMs, etc
  • Experience with large scale data processing (e.g., Hands-on experience training and applying models at scale using deep learning frameworks like PyTorch or Tensorflow)
  • Successful candidates in this role need to be able to bridge state of the art approaches to real world impact
  • A cloud-native software craftsperson with hands on experience with containers, container orchestration, and distributed systems
  • An engineer with a self-driven attitude who can own problems and deliver solutions
  • Strong software fundamentals with experience in design patterns, refactoring, OOP, and testing
  • A cloud practitioner who values the “shift-left” mentality by building systems with Infrastructure as Code, not console clicking
  • Data’s at the heart of our systems, we hope it's yours too. You’re comfortable working with SQL and/or NoSQL, understand database design, and data analysis
  • Experience building and consuming CI/CD pipelines
  • Someone who knows their way around the command line and has experience working with *nix systems
  • 5+ years working experience in the engineering teams that build large-scale ML-driven user-facing products
  • 3+ years experience leading cross-team engineering efforts
  • Strong execution skills in project management
Xometry is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

title: Growth Marketing Manager for Startup Accelerator
description:
Location: Remote
Job Type: Full-Time
Salary: (Competitive – Based on Experience)

About the Founder Institute:

The Founder Institute (FI) is a global network of startup incubators, accelerators, and investors on a mission to activate and empower communities of entrepreneurs worldwide.

Since 2009, we’ve helped launch over 8,000 companies in 200+ cities globally, which have raised nearly $2BN in funding. We are based in Silicon Valley and have remote team members across the United States, Europe, India, and Brazil. Our success has been documented in the New York Times , BusinessWeek , Forbes , TechCrunch , and more.

About the Role:

We are seeking a Growth Marketing Manager with a passion for startups and entrepreneurship to join our team. The Growth Marketing Manager will lead the strategy and execution of all FI public online events, and be tasked with significantly increasing event attendance across all events. You will report directly to the Co-Founder & CEO of FI, have the opportunity to see entrepreneurship and venture capital from many angles, and work with a small and mission-driven team. This role is 100% remote.

Our Culture:

At the Founder Institute, we work a lot like the early-stage startups we support. That means things move fast, and we thrive on creativity, ownership, and a “let’s figure it out” mindset. Here’s what we look for in our team:

  • You’re naturally entrepreneurial, self-motivated, and enjoy tackling challenges head-on.
  • You prefer autonomy over hand-holding and don’t need a lot of oversight to get things done.
  • You love learning new things, and when you hit a roadblock, your first instinct is to dig in, research, and find a solution—Google is your best friend.
  • You’re open to feedback (even when it’s tough), and always looking to grow and improve—both personally and as part of the team.

If that sounds exciting to you, we’d love to hear from you. If not, no hard feelings—this kind of environment isn’t for everyone.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Increase Event Attendance at Online Events: The main KPI for this role is event attendance, and the Growth Marketing Manager will independently test, develop, and execute new strategies to increase attendance at FI’s global and local online events - on a miniscule marketing budget.
  • Develop and Maintain Guidelines and Best Practices for Local FI Chapters: Develop local event marketing strategies, frameworks, and best-practices that can be executed by Local FI Chapters to increase attendance on local online events.
  • Train and Collaborate with Local FI Chapters: Train FI Chapters on the latest findings and best practices, troubleshoot their issues, and leverage their experience to form new strategies that can be deployed across other chapters.
  • Coordinate and Plan Global Online Events: Collaborate with other members of FI HQ to source, book, and coordinate with speakers for FI’s global online events.
  • Host and/or Produce Online Events: Collaborate and alternate with other members of FI HQ to host (emcee) online events, and/or produce them in the background to support the host.
  • Improve Site and Email Copy: Update and improve copy across our marketing materials to properly address the changing needs of our customers.
  • Maintain Organized Documentation & Processes: Track customer interactions, document frequently asked questions, and provide feedback to improve processes.

Qualifications and Skills:

Required:

  • 5+ years of online marketing experience
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills
  • Business-level fluency in English
  • Comfort on camera (you will host some live webinars with up to 1000 live attendees)
  • Knowledge of startup accelerators and the startup/venture capital industry
  • Ability to execute with a miniscule marketing budget and limited support resources
  • Experience running content marketing and social media marketing campaigns from beginning to end
  • Working knowledge and familiarity with common online event and marketing tools (ex. Zoom, Airmeet, Squarespace, Slack, Google Suite, Asana, Moz, Notion, Jasper, Canva)
  • Proactive attitude and ability to operate in a fast-moving and ambiguous environment (there is no micromanagement at FI)

Preferred:

  • Public Relations experience
  • Basic HTML/CSS/design experience
  • Experience using Powerpoint, Excel, Canva, Mailchimp, and various online CRM and marketing platforms

What We Offer:

  • Great upward mobility into a larger, conversion-focused marketing role (all senior team members at FI have grown into their roles from inside the company)
  • Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience.
  • Ability to join FI's Equity Collective, providing monetary upside in FI Alumni companies
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Remote Flexibility: Work from anywhere with the autonomy to drive results in your own style.
  • Ability to learn from top entrepreneurs, investors, and executives throughout FI’s global network and suite of acceleration programs.

IMPORTANT: In your Cover Letter please write two paragraphs, the first on why you would like to work in the startup accelerator industry, and the second on how your personality fits well with the FI culture described above. Applications without this Cover Letter will be ignored.

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The senior role will serve as a driver and practitioner in both regional and global HR initiatives. You will join a global team of HR professionals to provide precise, compliant and scalable HR operations to the business, advise and execute on HR issues across the whole employee life-cycle, and partner with leadership in your region.   • Partner with people managers to support the delivery of appropriate training and development programs
  • Establish a trusted partnership with the business in your region
  • Drive diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives
  • Design new policies and deliver on business-critical HR related projects globally
What we are looking for in you
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • HR experience leading initiatives across regions within a technology business
  • Regional HR experience within Latin America (Brazil and/or Mexico is a plus), with an understanding of local labor laws, competitive awareness and insights
  • Experience in business partnering with senior stakeholders
  • A good balance between leading and executing, in this role you will need to be hands-on involved in the daily HR routines
  • Experience mentoring and developing others
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to define done and keep deliverables on track
  • Experience in working in a remote first organization
  • Able to leverage data to make informed decisions
  • Fluent in business English (written and spoken)
  • Self motivated, organized, accurate, confident, authentic, results-orientated, open-minded and enthusiastic
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
Nice to have skills
  • Experience with immigration policies and mobility processes
  • Payroll and/or benefits oversight experience
  • Knowledge of HR Systems and databases
  • Professional HR certification(s)
  • Facilitation skills
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Open source software is the new default in the enterprise, and Canonical is the new challenger to major enterprise software vendors.
We deliver better open source from the data center to cloud and edge. Our Linux distribution Ubuntu is now the leading platform for public cloud compute, and the favorite platform for software engineers, data scientists and AI developers. Our mission is to accelerate the adoption and quality of open source globally, and our goal is to ship the most software on the planet by cores. A tidal wave of open source innovation is the next phase of the entire enterprise software industry, and we aim to be the most compelling way to ride that wave.
Our customers include Global 500 enterprises and startups. We are expanding our product range from the base operating system - Ubuntu - to full enterprise solutions in infrastructure and applications. We can deliver software defined storage, private cloud solutions, container runtime environments, as well as databases, message queues, identity, observability, analytics, machine learning and web publishing capabilities. Customers love the idea that they can get security compliance and support for everything open source from a single company. Our goal is to have more solutions on tap than any other vendor, and we have built unique capabilities to make that possible across every cloud, every class of compute and every category of application.
Canonical provides licensed enterprise software products, commercial support, managed services, consulting and training services to customers who are deploying Ubuntu or open source applications on the cloud, in their data center, or to the connected device and IoT ecosystem. We are just over 1,000 colleagues in 70+ countries and $250m in revenue, profitable, on a steady but relentless growth trajectory. We are almost entirely distributed, with leadership spread across many countries. We believe that talent is equally distributed across the globe, and we are excited to hire, develop, promote and ultimately trust a diverse group of exceptional leads to build the best, not biggest, enterprise software company.
We hire carefully and deliberately; our selection process is long and requires substantial work from applicants. It will take successful applicants three to six months to secure an offer. This is not a place to apply if you are in a rush to find a position, it is a worthwhile place to apply if you are ambitious and long-term in your thinking about your career and the dynamics which move the world forward. If you see clearly the rise of open source, and you understand the drivers of enterprise procurement and technical decision making, then you will understand why Canonical has such a tremendous long term advantage. You will also understand, given the ferocity of competition and the challenges of competing in a market of giants, that we have to set a very high bar for hiring and performance. In order to be a world leading company we select for exceptional ability as well as character, and then provide an environment which promotes teamwork and celebrates diligence, collaboration and effectiveness. All of those are easy to say but hard to do - at Canonical we are willing to be uncomfortable in pursuit of that excellence.
In building our sales team, we look for five things:

  • Empathy for the customer - a real understanding of customer needs, industry-specific challenges, and a desire to help customers solve their business problems
  • High intellect - the ability to learn quickly, understand very complex subjects, and communicate clearly to build trust and confidence
  • Passion for technology - a fascination with the state of the art from brilliant people solving hard problems, and fierce competition for large prizes
  • Teamwork - a willingness to help others, to collaborate well with people from different disciplines, and to balance personal and team ambitions
  • Energy - the drive to motivate oneself and others to achieve the best result for the team and our customers
Ubuntu is already very widely adopted which gives us a credible basis for conversations in the market. Nevertheless, it requires real work for sales professionals to build on that adoption to create trusted and profitable commercial relationships with the enterprises in their territory. Our product managers and marketing teams run campaigns to generate awareness, engagement and leads, but you will need to go beyond managing inbound interest to develop the potential of your territory. You will need judgement as to which industries and companies are ready to go deeper with open source and Canonical, and energy to develop relationships in advance of proven interest. We expect professional practice, territory and account planning, as well as clear, complete and continuous reporting on pipeline status and activity, using standard professional tools.
The successful candidate will carry an annual bookings quota within their assigned territory. They should be able to travel regionally for client engagement, industry conferences, and internationally for company events twice a year. They will be expected to demonstrate professionalism and effectiveness, to prospect accounts for new business, maintain and develop existing relationships, and work with colleagues and partners on account strategy. They must be comfortable selling enterprise software, open source, cloud, virtualization, container technologies and technical software solutions to senior levels of the enterprise.
Location: We are expanding our sales organisation globally and have open roles in every region.
What your day will look like
  • Represent the company, its solutions and software, in your territory
  • Build and execute a territory plan to prioritize outreach and prospecting
  • Develop new pipeline through outreach, prospecting, local marketing, and industry events
  • Close contracts to meet and exceed quarterly and annual bookings targets
  • Be mindful and proactive in achieving tactical and strategic objectives
  • Manage customer relationships and interactions through all stages of the sales cycle
  • Work with field engineers to propose solutions that solve our customers' business problems
  • Work with customer success to identify growth opportunities
  • Maintain accurate pipeline data and forecasts within Salesforce
  • Establish productive professional relationships with key influencers and decision makers
What we are looking for in you
  • Bachelor's level degree, preferably in engineering or computer science
  • Experience of open source technology and solutions
  • Detail oriented with effective follow-up
  • Experience in enterprise software or technology sales planning and execution
  • Track record of achievement in sales targets and new account wins
  • Self-discipline and motivation to be successful in a distributed team
  • Professional written and spoken English, as well as any language that may be appropriate for your target market
  • Ability to travel for customer engagements, industry events and company events
Additional Skills Of Interest
  • Specific vertical experience, in particular finance, telco, health, energy, public sector, tech
  • Experience speaking at conferences or industry events
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance when shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven commission structure. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a fully distributed company since its inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
About CloudWalk:

We are not just another fintech unicorn. We are a pack of dreamers, makers, and tech enthusiasts building the future of payments. With millions of happy customers and a hunger for innovation, we're now expanding our neural network - literally and metaphorically.

Behind every strategic decision is a structure that enables growth with agility and efficiency. Our Procurement team plays a key role in scaling our operations, building intelligent processes, and negotiating with precision and insight.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Senior Procurement Analyst to strengthen our purchasing operations through advanced negotiation, process optimization, and data-driven insights. You’ll be responsible for managing vendor relationships, leading negotiations, and using SAP and AI-powered tools to deliver efficiency and measurable results.

Your mission will be to drive procurement excellence by blending technology, strategic sourcing, and collaboration across teams — ensuring we get the best value from our suppliers while maintaining agility and control.


What You’ll Be Doing
  • Lead high-impact negotiations with vendors across financial, technology, and general services categories.
  • Manage the full procurement lifecycle: sourcing, negotiation, contracting, ordering, and supplier performance.
  • Use SAP for PR/PO flow, vendor management, and procurement analytics.
  • Implement and leverage AI tools for contract analysis, data modeling, and workflow automation.
  • Develop and monitor procurement KPIs (cost savings, lead times, compliance, supplier quality, etc.).
  • Collaborate closely with Finance, Legal and Operational Teams to ensure alignment and compliance.
  • Continuously improve procurement processes through automation, standardization, and risk mitigation.
  • Support vendor due diligence and onboarding, especially for strategic suppliers.
  • Monitor market trends to identify sourcing opportunities and optimize supplier strategies.
What You Need to Succeed
  • Proven experience in procurement or strategic sourcing.
  • Strong negotiation and vendor management skills.
  • Hands-on experience with SAP in procurement operations.
  • Familiarity with AI tools applied to procurement, analytics, or automation.
  • Excellent command of procurement KPIs and reporting (dashboards, insights, tracking).
  • Ability to lead process improvement and implement best practices.
  • Solid understanding of procurement compliance, contract terms, and risk management.
  • Advanced English communication skills (spoken and written).
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and cross-functional collaboration mindset.
Nice to Have
  • Experience working in companies within the financial services sector (banks, fintechs, credit institutions).
  • Experience leading cost reduction initiatives or strategic contract renegotiations.
  • Exposure to designing procurement policies and purchasing workflows.
  • Familiarity with financial, tech, or facilities sourcing categories.
  • Participation in digital transformation initiatives within Procurement.
  • Ability to thrive in autonomous and cross-functional environments.

Join us at CloudWalk, where we’re not just engineering solutions; we’re building a smarter, AI-driven future for payments—together.

title: Factory Technician
description:
Aker QRILL Company is a world leader in the sustainable production of krill-based products. We are dedicated to enhancing the nutritional value of feed for aquaculture and livestock and contributing to a more sustainable global food system. Our business has experienced consistent growth within the Aker BioMarine organization. In 2024 we were spun out as a stand-alone entity, and we remain a reputable company in the maritime industry known for a focus on operational excellence.

We are now looking for a Factory Technician who will work on board our vessels in Antarctica.

Factory Technician

The Factory Technician reports to the Factory Manager on board and is responsible for Krill Meal and Krill Oil production onboard the vessel during his/her shift. Maintenance work of factory equipment must be expected. The Factory Technician may also be set to operate other machinery and being involved in other production onboard the ship. The position is not set to a specific vessel and may change during the season if required or by request from management.

Responsibilities during operation

  • Responsible for operating production process and make sure that production is optimized during operation, in accordance with quality and safety procedures
  • Participate in maintenance work as requested by Factory Manager and Factory Mechanic during factory shut-downs, shipyard stays and lay-ups
  • Participate in other jobs as requested by Factory Manager
  • Report to Factory Manager and/or Factory Mechanic regarding any changes of inventory
  • Keep up to date all processing logs as required
  • Create handover notes before crew-change for on-boarding Factory Technician
  • Learn and understand how to use ERP system TM Master as required

Professional qualifications:

  • A background as process engineer or process technician
  • Relevant competence and experience from process operation, preferably within the fishmeal industry
  • Knowledge of Scada systems for process control
  • Technical and mechanical understanding

Personal qualifications:

  • Have good English knowledge (work language)
  • Enjoy working in an international team
  • Appreciate new challenges
  • Drive and self-motivation, seeking out new tasks and improvements

CV must reflect required qualifications specified.

We offer:

  • A safe and attractive workplace
  • Possibility for entrance into a fixed position on board
  • Fixed annual salary
  • Good working environment on board
  • Pension and insurance scheme
  • 12/7 shift; 12 hours on, 12 hours off, 7 days a week for the entire rotation
  • Shift rotation: One shift on (ca three months incl travels) and two shifts off, averaging 150 sea days per year and about 120 - 135 days off between trips. Travel to and from fishing ground is about one week each way at the beginning and the end of the rotation, using ports in Uruguay, Chile, and Falkland Islands for embarkation on cargo and passenger vessel, bringing crew to fishing vessels on fishing ground.

Location: Vessel/Antarctica

Travel and rotation

Crew changes are normally arranged in Montevideo, Punta Arenas and Puerto Williams. Rotation is approximately 8 weeks on and off but may deviate slightly due to operation.

Application and contact information

Does this sound like an exciting opportunity? Please don't hesitate to apply as we will be contacting candidates on an ongoing basis.

Please send your application letter and CV in either English or Norwegian via the application link. Questions may be directed to .

About Aker QRILL Company:

We develop ingredients for use in the aquaculture and animal feed markets, as well as deliver raw materials for production of human health supplements. Our value chain stretches from our vessels and sustainable krill harvesting operations in Antarctica, through our logistics hub in Montevideo, and all the way to customers around the world.

The Company operates a fleet of four vessels, including one cargo vessel and three fishing vessels, leading krill fishing within the Antarctic region. The three fishing vessels operate on the fishing grounds year-round, except for one month in October, which is dedicated to maintenance and repairs while the cargo vessel transports products and crew to and from the fishing grounds throughout the year.

Our offices are located in Fornebu and Ålesund, with the logistics base and product warehouse in Montevideo, Uruguay. We are about 500 employees globally, of which about 430 work on board our krill vessels in Antarctica. We are a diverse company with more than 25 nationalities, spread across all time zones and most continents. Together, we form an international, high performing, diverse and fun work environment.

Working with us means you appreciate diversity, are highly skilled within your field and can cope with unexpected situations. You enjoy a fast pace, tolerate quick decisions and continuously ongoing changes. You are a true team player who “chips in” when the situation requires so.

QRILL Aqua is a functional feed ingredient for shrimp, marine fish, and salmonids, increasing productivity in aquaculture - through improved growth, health and quality.

QRILL Pet is a functional ingredient for pet nutrition with documented health benefits for companion animals. Proven in numerous studies to benefit pet health, the omega-3s help maintain the health of the heart, kidneys, liver, joints, brain, eyes, skin and coat.

Why should you be part of our team?

You can expect hard work and a lot of fun and challenges. In return we promise you will be part of an exciting journey. If you show initiative and desire for more responsibility, we will give it to you and support you along the way. We strongly believe that our team of people want to do their best. All in the spirit of being the leading company in our industry and always striving to raise the bar.

title: Analista Fiscal
description:
Responsabilidades do Analista Fiscal

  1. Experiência Fiscal: O analista fiscal deve ter experiência na área, com um bom entendimento das obrigações fiscais e tributárias de diferentes tipos de empresas. Essa experiência permite o gerenciamento das rotinas fiscais de forma eficiente e o cumprimento das obrigações legais.
  2. EFC Contribuições: O analista é responsável pela Escrituração Fiscal das Contribuições (EFC), que envolve a apuração e escrituração das contribuições devidas, como PIS, COFINS e CSLL. Esse processo garante o cumprimento das obrigações e a correta apuração dos impostos, evitando problemas com o fisco.
  3. EFC ICMS IPI: Outra atividade importante é a Escrituração Fiscal do ICMS e IPI . O analista fiscal deve fazer a apuração e a escrituração desses tributos indiretos, essenciais para empresas do setor de comércio e indústria. Isso inclui o controle de notas fiscais de entradas e saídas, apuração dos créditos e débitos e o envio das declarações obrigatórias.
  4. Simples Nacional: O analista fiscal também deve atuar na escrituração fiscal do Simples Nacional , regime tributário destinado a microempresas e empresas de pequeno porte. Ele realiza a apuração e o correto preenchimento das obrigações fiscais, conforme as exigências desse regime.
  5. Escrituração Fiscal do Simples Nacional: O profissional é responsável por realizar a escrituração dos documentos fiscais da empresa optante pelo Simples Nacional. Isso inclui a correta apuração de tributos como ICMS, ISS e outros, bem como a preparação para a entrega das obrigações acessórias exigidas pela Receita Federal.
  6. ISS (Imposto Sobre Serviços): A gestão do ISS (Imposto Sobre Serviços) também é uma responsabilidade do analista fiscal. Ele deve apurar e escriturar corretamente esse imposto nas notas fiscais de serviços prestados, de acordo com as alíquotas e regras do município onde a empresa está estabelecida.
  7. Retenções Federais: O analista fiscal deve lidar com as retenções federais como IRRF, INSS, PIS, COFINS e CSLL, que são devidas nas operações de prestação de serviços. Ele garante que os cálculos sejam feitos corretamente, as retenções sejam aplicadas e que os valores sejam pagos e informados corretamente nas obrigações fiscais.
  8. Vivência em Escritório Contábil: Ter vivência em escritório contábil é uma experiência valorizada, pois o analista fiscal costuma interagir com outros departamentos, como o contábil, e fornecer informações e documentos fiscais para auxiliar na correta escrituração contábil. Além disso, a experiência no escritório contábil proporciona uma visão mais ampla das obrigações fiscais e contábeis da empresa.

WeWork is seeking a proactive self-starter who enjoys working in a challenging and fast-paced environment to support the Accounting Team with a focus on Fixed Assets/Construction and Operating Expense Accounting. Key Responsibilities

  • Assist with the monthly financial close by preparing account schedules, submitting journal entries and working cross functionally with other internal stakeholders to obtain relevant information

  • Support the year-end financial statement audit and quarterly reviews including internal audit and SOX requests
  • Assist the Senior Manager in developing the processes and controls needed to operate effectively while managing risk
  • Support the Senior Manager with various ad-hoc analyses and management reporting, specifically performing and developing analytics on operating expenses on a monthly, quarterly and annual basis
  • Collaborate and formulate working relationships with cross-functional teams including Finance, Building Operations, Construction Operations and Legal within WeWork

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Accounting or Finance

  • Proficient with MS Office with advanced excel skills and the ability to manipulate large data sets (VLOOKUP, Sum-Ifs, Pivot tables, etc.)
  • Strong working knowledge of accounting theory and application of US GAAP and Sarbanes-Oxley requirements
  • Excellent communication skills; proven ability to communicate effectively with internal and external business partners at various levels
  • Problem solver with strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple competing priorities while meeting deadlines
  • Familiarity with analytical process automation specifically Alteryx a plus
  • Working knowledge of Workday a plus

A energia para o futuro precisa ser projetada, planejada e construída hoje – nosso trabalho é dar o suporte necessário para que as melhores decisões sejam tomadas.

Trabalhamos com determinação para levar aos nossos clientes informações qualificadas, adequadas aos processos regulatórios e à realidade nacional.

Buscamos um Analista de Preços e Estudos de Mercado interessado em atuar em uma das maiores empresas brasileiras de consultoria e gestão de energia.

  • Mapeamento e monitoramento constante das principais variáveis que interferem na formação dos preços de energia de curto e longo prazo;
  • Elaboração de análises e estudos multidisciplinares relacionados a cenários futuros de preços spot do PLD, preços de mercado, PLD horário, encargos setoriais, GSF, entre outros;

  • Microsoft Office avançado;

  • Desejável: conhecimento em programação (Python, R ou VBA) e Power BI;
  • 3 anos de experiência no setor atuando em áreas como Planejamento Energético, Regulação, gestão de consumidores/geradores, e de Estudos e Modelos Energéticos.

Alguns dos nossos benefícios:

  • Vale alimentação;
  • Valorização da saúde e bem-estar | grupo de corrida e/ou ciclismo (EQ Performance);

A Thymos foi fundada em janeiro de 2013 com o objetivo de contribuir com o avanço do setor de energia em termos de gestão e eficiência. Um seleto grupo de profissionais decidiu investir em conhecimento – requisito fundamental para balizar a modernização do setor elétrico e para promover o desenvolvimento de mercados de energia elétrica e gás natural estruturados, baseados na livre concorrência, capazes de dinamizar a economia nacional e impulsionar o crescimento econômico do Brasil.

Hoje, a Thymos oferece soluções de ponta a ponta da cadeia: geração, transmissão, distribuição, comercialização e consumo, além de orientar investidores que buscam oportunidades nesses segmentos. Seus profissionais deram suporte à negociação de mais de 6.000 MW médios em processos de compra de curto, médio e longo prazos em 2019 e gerenciam mensalmente mais de 2.000 MW médios de energia para consumidores, geradores e distribuidoras.

A Thymos Energia conta com excelente infraestrutura para oferecer ao mercado seus principais serviços – consultoria em energia, gestão de energia, pesquisa e desenvolvimento – com seriedade e competência. Seus estudos bem fundamentados, a alta qualidade técnica de seus projetos, relatórios e análises de mercado e a excelente interlocução da equipe com os mais diversos órgãos e entidades do setor são os marcos de uma trajetória de sucesso.

O setor de energia ainda tem muito a avançar e apresenta grandes desafios. Nos novos cenários que vêm surgindo, os estudos técnicos, as pesquisas e análises, as projeções e antecipações de tendência serão ainda mais importantes para agentes, investidores e para a sociedade. Os profissionais da Thymos estarão aqui, prontos para contribuir com o futuro do setor.

title: Product Manager
description:
We're looking for a talented and passionate Product Manager to join Wildlife's Live Games team. Wildlife is constantly growing and launching worldwide games because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with engineers, artists, designers, distribution specialists, data scientists, among others, to help develop games that impact people's lives all over the globe.

As a Wildlife Product Manager, you will work with the game leader to execute the game's vision throughout the development cycle, using data and accurate business sense to improve the game's performance. You will be the owner of multiple features' development, accountable for the results of your own tests and the analysis associated to improve the game.

We know that the work we do has a high impact on our company's success and culture. The right person for this position is curious by nature, and comfortable in a "take the initiative" environment, loves solving problems, and can thrive in a fast and growing business.

What you'll do

  • Work with the game leader on the entire product life cycle from formulating product strategy and presenting clear, measurable objectives to day-by-day tactical activities;
  • Participate on game's vision definition and work on the backlog for the product (i.e., macro and micro product roadmap);
  • Own the process of all your responsibilities inside the game from end-to-end;
  • Coordinate actions within the core team and with related teams (engineering, art, distribution, data science);
  • Provide product leadership (through your own experience, data analyses, benchmarks, customer/expert interviews, etc.) within the product's core team;
  • Drive a solution set across development teams through market requirements, product specifications, and positioning;
  • Work with customers and stakeholders to drive alignment and communicate product updates;
  • Analyze potential partner relationships for the product and have an active role in new product development.

What you'll need

  • Business degree & similars
  • Advanced analytics skills (e.g., statistics, AI, ML)
  • Strong familiarity with Wildlife’s games and mobile products
  • Outstanding written, oral and organizational ability

Nice to have

  • Advanced Excel/Google Sheets skills

More about you

  • Excited about joining one of Brazil's most valuable startups, where you'll find challenging work, opportunities to build strong professional relationships, continuous learning, and a team committed to delivering great products.
  • Thoughtful and analytical decision-maker: you consider multiple solutions to the same problem and can see nuance where others don't to decide what level of detail/sophistication you’ll need to make an informed timely decision;
  • A structured and creative thinker: with a structured mindset you are able to harness chaos into a logical architecture, where others would give-up you won't, and by digging into benchmarks you're able to uncover unthinkable solutions to your day-by-day problems;
  • A natural but humble leader and mentor: as an accomplished leader, you're able to speak on a broad spectrum of topics; your demeanor diffuses conflicts and puts people at ease, helping you give constructive feedback and build relationships across cultures and interacting and coordinating the work of several teams, to extract the most value from each team member;
  • A multicultural gamer: you love gaming (console, mobile, board, or card games) as much as we do, so you'll plug that passion into providing players' needs with unparalleled focus.

About Wildlife

Wildlife is one of the leading mobile game developers and publishers in the world. We have released more than 60 titles, reaching billions of people around the globe. Here, we create games that will excite, intrigue, and engage our players for years to come!

  • Self-Direction: Proactive mindset with the ability to identify opportunities and drive them forward independently.

  • Experience with popular BI tools such as Tableau, Looker, or similar.

  • Experience in marketing: attribution, UTM parameters, ROAS.

  • Bachelor's degree in relevant field.

Location

WinTech operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.

Benefits

Discover the perks of being part of our vibrant team! We offer:

  • Remote Work Environment: Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere, anytime, promoting a healthy work-life balance.

  • Unlimited PTO: Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well-being, without counting days.

This role offers an exciting opportunity to push the industry forward by enabling entirely new Linux based hardware testing capabilities, scaling up hardware certification efforts and allowing for deeper test coverage.
The role involves the development and maintenance of Canonical's open source certification tools, supporting the creation of hardware solutions for test automation, and automating our existing processes. We seek out continuous process and tooling improvements as part of expanding the certification test suites, ultimately to improve the quality of Linux experience felt by millions of Linux end users.

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
If you're seeking a career where innovation meets impact, you've come to the right place. As a global leader, Sovos is transforming tax compliance from a business requirement to a force for growth while revolutionizing how businesses navigate the ever-changing regulatory landscape. At Sovos, we're dedicated to more than just solving compliance challenges – we're committed to making a positive and lasting difference in everything we do. Our teams operate on the modern edge of digital technology, working not only to solve complex business challenges but also to enrich our personal, professional, and local communities.

Our purpose-built systems provide the tools you need to thrive in a world where governments demand increased visibility, faster reporting and greater control over business processes. Excited about the possibilities? So are we!

Don’t worry if you don't check all the boxes – apply anyway! We're focused on hiring the right people, not just the "right" resume. It's not about what you've done elsewhere; it's all about what you're capable of doing here.

The Work You'll Do:

We are looking for a Project Manager to lead Tax Determination implementations in Brazil, with a strong focus on regulatory compliance and delivery excellence. This role will oversee the full project lifecycle—from planning and stakeholder alignment to go-live—ensuring that the Taxrules platform is deployed effectively and in accordance with Brazilian tax legislation.

More specifically you will:

  • Manage end-to-end delivery of Tax Determination projects using the Taxrules platform, including planning, execution, and closure.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams including Solution Consultants, Regulatory, Product, and Integration specialists.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, managing expectations, timelines, and escalations.
  • Ensure compliance with Brazilian tax regulations (ICMS, IPI, PIS, COFINS, ISS, DIFAL) throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Lead weekly status meetings, maintain project documentation, and deliver concise progress reports.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to ensure resource availability and risk mitigation.

What We Need From You

  • Proven experience managing tax technology or ERP-related projects in Brazil.
  • Strong understanding of Brazilian tax legislation and its application in automated systems.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Proficiency in project management tools and methodologies (Agile, PMP, etc.).
  • Fluent in Portuguese and English.
  • Experience with REST API integrations and tax content configuration.
  • Background in consulting or professional services delivery.
  • Knowledge of e-invoicing frameworks (NF-e, NFS-e, CT-e, NFcom) and tax reform impacts.

What Does Sovos Offer You?

The tools to enhance your life - because we want you to enjoy your life outside of work and inside!

  • Twice-Monthly Meeting Free Days
  • Management Bootcamps and Development Trainings
  • Yearly performance reviews where compensation and performance are assessed and rewarded generously
  • Clear paths for growth within our roles (but we know that career development can be like a spider web, not a ladder - we give you the tools to move outside of your career as well!
  • Generous time off and benefits

Sovos is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing an environment that celebrates diversity and where equal employment opportunities are available to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate against race, color, religions, national origin, age, sex, marital status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic provided by law. At Sovos, all employees are encouraged to bring their whole selves to work.

Company Background

Sovos is a global provider of tax, compliance and trust solutions and services that enable businesses to navigate an increasingly regulated world with true confidence. Purpose-built for always-on compliance capabilities, our scalable IT-driven solutions meet the demands of an evolving and complex global regulatory landscape. Sovos’ cloud-based software platform provides an unparalleled level of integration with business applications and government compliance processes.

More than 100,000 customers in 100+ countries – including half the Fortune 500 – trust Sovos for their compliance needs. Sovos annually processes more than three billion transactions across 19,000 global tax jurisdictions. Bolstered by a robust partner program more than 400 strong, Sovos brings to bear an unrivaled global network for companies across industries and geographies. Founded in 1979, Sovos has operations across the Americas and Europe, and is owned by Hg and TA Associates. For more information visit and follow us onLinkedIn andTwitter .
